Since $\overset{―}{kv}=\overset{―}{v},$ we get the following equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{kv} & =\overset{―}{k}\,\overset{―}{v} \\ [\begin{aligned}18-18\text{i} \\ 6-30\text{i}\end{aligned}] & =\overset{―}{k}\,\overset{―}{[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 3+2\text{i}\end{aligned}]} \\ [\begin{aligned}18-18\text{i} \\ 6-30\text{i}\end{aligned}] & =\overset{―}{k}\,[\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{3} \\ \overset{―}{3+2\text{i}}\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}18-18\text{i} \\ 6-30\text{i}\end{aligned}] & =\overset{―}{k}\,[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 3-2\text{i}\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}18-18\text{i} \\ 6-30\text{i}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}3\overset{―}{k} \\ (3-2\text{i})\overset{―}{k}\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

So, we obtain the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}3\overset{―}{k}=18-18\text{i} \\ (3-2\text{i})\overset{―}{k}=6-30\text{i}.\end{aligned}
$$

From the first equation, we get

$$
\overset{―}{k}=6-6\text{i}
$$

Substituting this into the second equation, we obtain the true statement

$$
(3-2\text{i})(6-6\text{i})=6-30\text{i}
$$

Therefore, $k=\overset{―}{6-6\text{i}}=6+6\text{i}.$

Finally, $\text{Re}(k)=6.$
